indicators.explanation: Household debt-service context

indicators.explanation: Market-volatility context

indicators.name: Financial Stress Index
indicators.explanation: Below-average broad financial stress

indicators.name: Credit Conditions
indicators.explanation: Credit conditions are not showing broad stress

indicators.name: Margin Debt / GDP
indicators.explanation: Leverage context; FINRA value retained when available

indicators.name: Public Equity Market / GDP
indicators.explanation: Buffett-style valuation ratio using Federal Reserve Z.1 public equities; descriptive context, not a crash timer
indicators.source: Manual / Federal Reserve Z.1 + FRED GDP
indicators.methodology: BOGZ1FL883164115Q public corporate equities in millions divided by nominal GDP in billions after converting equities to billions

indicators.name: Shiller CAPE
indicators.explanation: Long-run valuation context from Robert Shiller / Yale; not an imminent-crash signal
indicators.methodology: Cyclically adjusted price/earnings ratio from the official Yale Shiller data workbook
